ov: A small, semiaquatic mole of wet lowlands in northeastern North America. Its nose is a star of 22 fleshy tentacles with over 25,000 touch sensors, which it uses instead of its eyes to find prey. It is active day and night, all year round.
rg: Moist, low areas of northeastern North America.
df: Aquatic insects, worms, leeches, molluscs and small crustaceans.
fx: It can smell underwater by blowing bubbles onto objects and sniffing them back in.
It swims well and has been seen tunnelling through snow and swimming under ice.
